test_cases.description: Verify entry into Harmonizing mode when IVT_Mode_ModeLgc is True and Harmonizing_Active_STL remains True for 10 consecutive STL frames.
test_cases.initial_condition: IVT_Mode_ModeLgc = True; Harmonizing_Active_STL = False at frame 0.
test_cases.test_inputs: Frames 1-10: Harmonizing_Active_STL = True; Frames 11+: any value.
test_cases.expected_result: LRU enters Harmonizing mode at frame 10.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Mode change to Harmonizing detected at frame 10.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Set IVT_Mode_ModeLgc to True. Set Harmonizing_Active_STL to True for 10 consecutive frames. Verify that the LRU transitions to Harmonizing mode at the end of frame 10.

test_cases.description: Boundary test: Harmonizing_Active_STL is True for exactly 10 consecutive frames.
test_cases.initial_condition: IVT_Mode_ModeLgc = True; Harmonizing_Active_STL = False at frame 0.
test_cases.test_inputs: Frames 1-10: Harmonizing_Active_STL = True; Frame 11: Harmonizing_Active_STL = False.
test_cases.expected_result: LRU enters Harmonizing mode at frame 10 and remains until a change occurs.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Mode change to Harmonizing detected at frame 10 and no premature transition before frame 10.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Confirm that the LRU does not enter Harmonizing mode before frame 10 and does so exactly at frame 10.

test_cases.description: Robustness test: Harmonizing_Active_STL is True for 9 frames, then False, then True again for 10 frames; verify no premature entry.
test_cases.initial_condition: IVT_Mode_ModeLgc = True; Harmonizing_Active_STL = False at frame 0.
test_cases.test_inputs: Frames 1-9: Harmonizing_Active_STL = True; Frame 10: Harmonizing_Active_STL = False; Frames 11-20: Harmonizing_Active_STL = True.
test_cases.expected_result: No entry into Harmonizing mode at frame 9; entry occurs at frame 20.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Mode change to Harmonizing detected only at frame 20, not before frame 10.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Verify that the LRU does not transition to Harmonizing mode during the first 9 frames and only after a continuous 10-frame period starting at frame 11.

test_cases.description: Verify that Harmonizing mode is not entered when IVT_Mode_ModeLgc is False even if Harmonizing_Active_STL is True for 10 frames.

test_cases.test_inputs: Frames 1-10: Harmonizing_Active_STL = True; Frames 11+: any value.
test_cases.expected_result: LRU does not enter Harmonizing mode during frames 1-10.
test_cases.pass_criteria: No mode change to Harmonizing detected during the 10-frame period.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Set IVT_Mode_ModeLgc to False. Set Harmonizing_Active_STL to True for 10 consecutive frames. Confirm that the LRU remains in its current mode.
